attributes.storage_note: Keep away from direct sunlight – store the bottles in a cool, dark place to prevent heat and light from breaking down the fragrance oils. Avoid humidity – do not keep perfumes in bathrooms or damp areas; moisture can alter their composition. Store upright – always keep bottles standing straight to prevent leakage and maintain fragrance stability.
